title: AstraZeneca与Alexion的gMG疗法获FDA批准进入拥挤市场
originalTitle: AstraZeneca, Alexion's myasthenia gravis treatment enters crowded market
summary: AstraZeneca与Alexion的通用名药物gefurolimab（Klygefa）获FDA批准用于重症肌无力治疗。该药物为每周一次的自体注射制剂，此次批准使gMG领域新增一种生物制剂。需注意该适应症已有罗氏的Lemtrada和诺华的Savilumab上市。

story.title: AstraZeneca and Alexion's Klygefa approved by FDA for generalized myasthenia gravis

author: Nicole DeFeudis
